notes.title: Seven Days - Minor Update Live
notes.notes:
This update fixes the following:
[list][*]Fixed a display bug that made it look like Shuuichi is attacking multiple targets when using the Attack command against the Demon Lord.[/list]

notes.title: The Purple Envelope Is Open!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33626697/65b9c316ca471c72d455d3aec136f1f7303d45d1.png[/img]
Thank you for waiting!

The promised extra chapter, Purple Envelope, is now available to play in Seven Days!

Please enjoy this touching extra chapter / epilogue featuring everyone's favorite neighborhood exorcist, Murasaki!

The Purple Envelope has been translated to English by Andrew Hodgson aka. Steiner. To play it, simply update the game to the latest version (the Purple Envelope is available to play after finishing the main story).

The game has also been updated with various minor text fixes.

notes.title: Seven Days Trading Cards Added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33626697/e299a4f6f6f4d5c50cf3de58b6e1bcb6f537f8f9.png[/img]
Good news, everyone!

Trading cards have just been added to Seven Days!

Cute cards, badges, emoji and backgrounds await all players! Simply play the game to unlock your free cards!

notes.title: Seven Days Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33626697/139c3f40d1826800370e01d687296496cf83b29f.png[/img]
[i]Let's play an occult mystery visual novel where all the heroines are dead![/i]

Happy Friday the 13th! We're happy to announce that LIFE0's occult mystery visual novel [b]Seven Days[/b] is now available to play on Steam, with a -10% launch discount until December 21!

Features
[list][*]Full HD graphics
[*]Original art by Miko
[*]Heroines fully voiced by top voice actors
[*]Supports English and Japanese languages[/list]
Japanese voice acting for the game is provided by Uesaka Sumire, Kiritani Choucho,Fujita Masayo, Aranami Kazusa, Shimizu Ai, Shimizu Ayaka, Toda Megumi, Oohashi Ayuru, Maruyama Miki and Urata Wataru.

Further, the game has been updated from its original release in Japan with all-new illustrations thanks to a successful Kickstarter campaign!

[i]Will you be able to grant these seven girls the end they wish for?[/i]

We hope you will enjoy this heartfelt story with us.

notes.title: Dual Language Added!
notes.notes:
We've got some happy tidings for you just ahead of the official Steam release - which is scheduled for tomorrow, December 13 at 17:00 PST!

Seven Days will officially support dual language at launch - you will be able to freely swap between [b]English and Japanese languages[/b] in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33626697/33db010ebcfb7e3df49975231224ebe133b98224.png[/img]

[i]Will you be able to grant these seven girls the end they wish for?[/i]

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/931560/Seven_Days/]wishlist the game on the store page[/url] to be notified when it launches!

notes.title: Collector's Edition Is Funded!
notes.notes:
The Seven Days collector's edition campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/215814918/seven-days-a-haunting-collectors-edition]Kickstarter[/url] has been funded in only 11 days! Thank you all!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/215814918/seven-days-a-haunting-collectors-edition][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33626697/905abd838d045e653a44e8e5ecd63d03aa7d355a.jpg[/img][/url]

We're now working toward the stretch goals that will improve the game and the pledges - we're currently less than $1000 away from the first stretch goal that will add an exclusive digital artbook to all game tiers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33626697/b4bcae3cbcf59ca57ac67a6a69ba86edaa69ec4f.jpg[/img]

Further stretch goals include adding all-new CGs to the game, as well as localizing the audio drama.

Please take a look and consider helping us fund the extra goals in return for exclusive rewards!

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show and Kickstarter
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Seven Days With You: The Most Precious Memory With You (aka Seven Days) will be coming to Steam this winter!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33626697/67b6c708807784b8426b0e393c4bde2a6a6ad80b.jpg[/img]

Seven Days is produced by LIFE0 in full HD, with wonderful art by the popular artist Miko, and top voice talents.

We have just launched a Kickstarter to produce a physical limited Collector's Edition of Seven Days - you can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/215814918/seven-days-a-haunting-collectors-edition]check it out here[/url]!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/215814918/seven-days-a-haunting-collectors-edition][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33626697/e0252ba996097295b1b5d5833e7eb2e1d0b7f6fd.png[/img][/url]

We're also having a booth at [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/event.html]Tokyo Game Show[/url] this week, from September 20 to 23, so if you have a chance, do come visit us! Our booth is in hall 3, booth 3-S03 (near Level-5). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33626697/17659d3626570c5c07c4b417b1d06b4b2e429339.jpg[/img]
(Photo from Tokyo Game Show 2017)

The voice actress of Kanzaki Mitsuki from Seven Days, Maruyama Miki (who you may also know as the voice of Marie Poppo and Sora in 100% Orange Juice) will be one of the cosplayers staffing our booth!
